behavior: Required TextSnapshotBackend paired hooks own capture, independent saved duplication, immutable sampling access, compatibility, logical estimate/growth and complete resume staging. No default bounded fallback to separate unquoted workers exists.

TextContinuationSnapshot retains one opaque saved pair; restore and fork call one paired resume hook before installation. Existing host preparation, controller/capture ownership, read-only copy boundary and monotone logical budgets remain shared.
MLX opaque saved components privately retain native state and immutable saved sampling/input. No public native extraction, exchange or mutable component replacement is available from the saved owner.
The MLX unquoted pair uses its existing real allocation owners and completed copy workers in the established order. Bounded capture/copy rejects with typed UnknownBound before either worker.

Neutral tests exercise nonzero saved-state isolation after live progress/retirement, failed final native copy after sampler copying with no partial installation, non-refunded copy allowance, wrong-runtime and unpriced-policy rejection, and restore/fork continuation parity.

Native tests verify repeated saved component staging, unchanged installed state before exchange, copied pending values/history/RNG, repeatable restored decoder logits and foreign-executable rejection. Their manual sampler fixture is component evidence, not full resumed generation.
